title: ElevateXIndianWorkerDescriptionRecord
description: Standard multi-span schema for Dataset 4: Indian Informal Worker Descriptions and Verified Skill Annotations

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the record, e.g. IND-TLR-0001

worker_description.description: Original raw, unedited verbatim response from the worker in Hindi, Hinglish, or English

original_language.description: Primary linguistic mode of the worker description

script_type.description: Writing script of the verbatim description (Devanagari, Roman/Latin, or Mixed)

region.description: Geographic district, vocational cluster, or state if consented and appropriate (e.g. Delhi NCR, Kanpur UP)

occupation_id.description: Trade taxonomy identifier from occupation_taxonomy.csv, e.g. TRD-01

occupation.description: Standard trade domain name matching occupation_taxonomy.csv

secondary_occupations.description: Any secondary or auxiliary trades demonstrated in multi-trade work

experience_years.description: Self-reported years of work experience in this trade (null if not stated)

work_context.description: Operational working environment where trade is practiced

collection_date.description: Date of field interview collection in YYYY-MM-DD format (null if unknown/synthetic)

skill_spans.description: List of annotated actionable skill spans identified in worker_description

span_id.description: Identifier for the span, e.g. SP-01, SP-02

extracted_skill.description: Exact verbatim substring inside worker_description representing the actionable competence

start_offset.description: 0-indexed character start position of extracted_skill in worker_description

end_offset.description: 0-indexed character end position (exclusive) of extracted_skill in worker_description

skill_category.description: Functional capability classification for the extracted competence

canonical_skill.description: Standardized English capability term mapped to formal competency catalogs

alternative_skill_names.description: Synonymous skill labels or colloquial trade names

esco_uri.description: Direct concept URI from ESCO v1.2.1 Skills pillar (null if no exact match)

onet_soc_code.description: Associated O*NET-SOC occupation code (null if cross-sectoral)

nsqf_reference.description: Official Indian NQR Qualification Pack (QP) code or NOS reference (e.g. AMH/Q1947:NOS-101)

is_unmapped_skill.description: True if competence is unique to informal market and lacks an international ontology match

ambiguity_flag.description: True if description contains dialectal idioms or ambiguous claims requiring expert adjudication

notes.description: Field notes or annotator comments on dialect or tools

annotation_source.description: Entity that performed the initial annotation

annotation_status.description: Progress state through the human annotation quality control pipeline

source_type.description: Authenticity classification: real field collection, curriculum source, or marked synthetic test stub

source_reference.description: Traceable field collection batch ID, partner center, or curriculum syllabus citation

reviewer_id.description: Identifier of the secondary reviewer or adjudicator

consent_status.description: Verification that DPDP Act-compliant worker consent is documented
